title.zh: 纳指单周跌5.5%，AI债务风险引爆抛售潮，油价逼近110美元加剧通胀担忧
title.en: 纳指单周跌5.5%，AI债务风险引爆抛售潮，油价逼近110美元加剧通胀担忧

current_state.zh: Wall Street sold off sharply as AI infrastructure financing stress—epitomized by CoreWeave bonds yielding over 15% and its stock falling 12% Friday—combined with Brent crude near $110 and 10-year Treasury yields at 5.097%, pushing the Nasdaq 100 to a 5.5% weekly loss, its worst since April 2025.
